summary: Top KingWin Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held August 31, 2026. Shareholders approved an increase in authorized share capital from US$31.25M to US$625M, a variation of Class B share rights (increasing votes per share from 40 to 200, permitting free transferability without conversion, and enabling 1:200 conversion into Class A shares), a company name change to Nexpu Ltd, and adoption of new articles of association. Approximately 730,683 Class A and 139,942 Class B shares voted. These are routine governance approvals, not a special situation transaction.
